_comment: AMD hardware spec DB for the Static Gatekeeper. Values are approximate and vendor-published where possible; bandwidth in TB/s (1 TB/s = 1e12 B/s), memory in GB (decimal, 1 GB = 1e9 B). Prices are rough street/list estimates in USD and vary widely. Cited inline in 'notes'.

tiers.name: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo)
tiers.notes: Up to 128GB unified LPDDR5X-8000 shared CPU/GPU/NPU; ~256-bit bus -> ~0.256 TB/s. XDNA2 NPU ~50 TOPS (INT8). Great capacity, low bandwidth => memory-bound decode is slow. Tier 1 'real run' target via Lemonade. Price is a whole-system estimate.

tiers.name: Radeon RX 7800 XT
tiers.notes: 16GB GDDR6, 256-bit, ~624 GB/s. RDNA3, ROCm-capable. Entry Radeon tier.

tiers.name: Radeon RX 7900 XTX
tiers.notes: 24GB GDDR6, 384-bit, ~960 GB/s. RDNA3 flagship consumer; strong ROCm 'real run' target for Tier 2.

tiers.name: Radeon PRO W7800
tiers.notes: 32GB GDDR6, 256-bit, ~576 GB/s. Workstation-class ECC-capable Radeon PRO.

tiers.name: Radeon PRO W7900
tiers.notes: 48GB GDDR6, 384-bit, ~864 GB/s. Largest single-card workstation Radeon PRO; Tier 3 'real run' target.

tiers.name: Instinct MI300X
tiers.notes: 192GB HBM3, ~5.3 TB/s. Datacenter CDNA3. Tier 4 = SIMULATED here via gatekeeper math + reduced-population loop (no physical device). Huge VRAM enables persistent negative-result memory + large MCTS/population batches. Price per-GPU estimate.

tiers.name: Instinct MI325X
tiers.notes: 256GB HBM3E, ~6.0 TB/s. Datacenter CDNA3, larger/faster memory than MI300X. Tier 4 SIMULATED. Price per-GPU estimate.
